$comment: Canonical homes for shared utility primitives (FID-2026-0928-009 Part 2). The no-duplicate-shared-primitive ESLint rule reads this file: a top-level function/const declaration whose name is a key here is an ERROR unless the file is the symbol's declared owner (or listed in allowedFiles). Adding a canonical export = add one registry entry in the same PR. Paths are forward-slash relative to the repo root.

sleep.note: Typed Promise<void>; satisfies PollLoginStatusDeps-style dependency slots.

withTimeout.note: Rejecting timeout. The OSC resolve-value variant is deliberately named withTimeoutValue and lives in cli/src/utils/terminal-color-detection/osc-query.ts.

sha256.note: Hex SHA-256 over UTF-8. sha256Hex in agent-runtime is a re-export of this body.

isRecord.note: Plain-object guard excluding arrays. JSON/narrower variants must use a distinct descriptive name (isJSONObjectRecord, isPrimitiveRecord, isJSONRecord).

asOptionalString.note: Non-empty string or undefined, for untyped vendor payloads.

asOptionalNumber.note: Finite number or undefined; wire null coerces to undefined at the parser boundary.

toolDisplayName.note: Title-Case tool label (list_directory override + MCP server__tool stripping). The CLI sidebar's sentence-case variant is deliberately named sidebarToolDisplayName in cli/src/components/right-sidebar-format.ts (FID-2026-1010-005).

truncateSingleLine.note: Whitespace-collapsing one-line cap, maxLength defaulting to 160; callers pass their own ceiling (120 for the desktop collapse header, SUMMARY_MAX_LENGTH for the CLI cards).

renderToolInput.note: Pretty-prints a tool input for a transcript; '' for absent/empty input.

renderToolOutput.note: Pretty-prints a JSON tool result and reports its fence language.

asPositiveInt.note: Coerces a block-level input to an integer >= 1, stringified values included; undefined when the value carries no positive integer.

asBoolean.note: Coerces a block-level input boolean, stringified 'true'/'false' included; undefined when the value carries no boolean meaning.

traceRoundedRect.note: 2D canvas rounded-rect path helper shared by the office and billboard nameplates.

getRuntimeRequire.note: Module-scope require when the runtime provides one; undefined under Node ESM. packages/database keeps its own copy by design (zero-dependency package) and is listed in allowedFiles.
